name: @nomad/game-server
description: The Nomad Poker game server: one Durable Object per table, running @nomad/table-server with chips on the D1 ledger and hands recorded to R2.

scripts.deploy:staging: node scripts/drain.mjs staging && npm run build:staging && cf deploy --prebuilt --mode staging --secrets-file .secrets.staging.json
scripts.deploy:production: node scripts/drain.mjs production && npm run build:production && cf deploy --prebuilt --mode production --secrets-file .secrets.production.json
